pages.caption: 启动绿色项目
en: Our school started a green project last term.
The aim was simple: make the academic curriculum more practical.
Teachers wanted to educate students about the environment, not just prepare them for a written assessment.
pages.zh: 我们学校上学期启动了一个绿色项目。目标很简单：让学术课程更实用。老师想让学生真正了解环境，而不只是为一次书面考核做准备。

pages.caption: 科学班研究污染
en: At first only a few pupils were motivated.
Then a science class did some research on air pollution in the local community.
Their analysis of the data gave clear evidence: the school produced too much carbon emission.
pages.zh: 起初只有少数学生有干劲。后来一个科学班对社区里的空气污染做了研究。他们对数据的分析给出了明确证据：学校碳排放太高了。

pages.caption: 请教专家
en: The head teacher asked an expert for advice.
She said we should conserve every resource: turn off the lights, recycle paper and plastic, and buy efficient digital equipment.
pages.zh: 校长向一位专家请教。她说我们应该节约每一种资源：关灯、回收纸张和塑料、购买节能的电子设备。

pages.caption: 新技术与小菜园
en: New technology helped a lot — one innovation cut our electricity bill by a third.
Students also developed a small garden for sustainable food, and improved their computer literacy at the same time.
pages.zh: 新技术帮了大忙——一项创新就让电费降了三分之一。学生还在校园里开辟小菜园，种可持续食物，同时提高了电脑操作能力。

pages.caption: 项目的影响
en: The project had a real impact.
It raised the standard of our science lessons and benefited the local economy, because we bought vegetables from nearby farms.
pages.zh: 这个项目带来了实实在在的影响。它提高了科学课的标准，也让当地经济受益，因为蔬菜是从附近农场买的。

pages.caption: 政策支持与证书
en: But the biggest challenge was money.
The school asked the government for a policy to fund such projects for every individual school.
Two years later, students who finish the course get a qualification in environmental studies.
pages.zh: 但最大的挑战是钱。学校请政府出台政策，为每一所学校的这类项目提供资金。两年后，修完这门课的学生能拿到环境研究的资格证书。

pages.caption: 职业·就业
en: Anna spent ten years building her career in a large company.
Her employer paid a good salary, and last spring she got a promotion.
She had friendly colleagues, and her profession gave her real expertise.
pages.zh: 安娜在一家大公司花了十年打造自己的职业。雇主给她不错的薪水，去年春天她还升了职。同事关系融洽，这个行业也给了她真正的专业能力。

pages.caption: 晋升·薪水
en: But her workload grew, and she missed deadline after deadline.
She was no longer productive, and she began to doubt whether she was still competent.
At her last interview she had promised to work harder, but her body had other plans.
pages.zh: 但工作量越来越大，她一次又一次错过截止日期。她不再高产，也开始怀疑自己能不能胜任。最后一次面试时她承诺会更努力，可身体另有打算。

pages.caption: 工作量·截止日期
en: She could not sleep, and she noticed the first symptom of burnout.
Her doctor warned her about obesity, heart disease and high blood pressure.
"Your diet is poor and you get no exercise," he said.
pages.zh: 她睡不着觉，还发现自己出现了过劳的第一个症状。医生警告她肥胖、心脏病和高血压的风险。「你饮食很差，又不锻炼，」他说，「良好的营养和健康的生活方式，比高薪重要得多。

pages.caption: 营养·肥胖
en: "Good nutrition and a healthy lifestyle matter more than a big salary.

"

Anna took the advice seriously.
She started physical exercise three times a week and tried to keep a balance between work and rest.
pages.zh:
」

安娜认真接受了建议。她开始每周锻炼三次，努力在工作与休息之间保持平衡。治疗很简单——吃得更好、睡得更多、压力更小——而且有效。

pages.caption: 症状·治疗
en: The treatment was simple — better food, more sleep, less stress — and it worked.
Six months later her mental health had improved too.
She even thought about leaving and looking for employment elsewhere, but in the end she stayed and changed the way she worked.
pages.zh: 半年后，她的心理健康也改善了。她甚至想过离开，去别处找份工作，但最后她留下来，改变了工作方式。现在她在办公室讲预防，也讲公司应该提供怎样的医疗保健。

pages.caption: 身体的·疾病
en: Now she gives talks about prevention in the office and about the healthcare her company should offer.
"I want to retire early," she says, "but I want to be healthy enough to enjoy it.
pages.zh: 「我想早点退休，」她说，「但我得健康到能享受它。」

pages.caption: 城市的·乡村的
en: My grandparents grew up in a rural village.
There was one bus a day, no hospital and no proper transport.
Today that village is part of a fast-growing urban area, and the change has been enormous.
The population has doubled in twenty years.
pages.zh: 我祖父母在一个乡村长大。那时一天只有一班公交，没有医院，也没有像样的交通。今天那个村子已经变成快速扩张的城区的一部分，变化巨大。

pages.caption: 通勤·行人
en: Young people migrate from the countryside to find work, and the city keeps expanding.
New infrastructure — roads, water pipes, a train line — was built to serve them.
A sports facility and a library opened near the old market, which is located in the centre, and local residents can now commute to work in half an hour.
pages.zh: 二十年里人口翻了一番。年轻人从乡下迁来找工作，城市不断扩张。新的基础设施——道路、水管、一条铁路——为他们而建。

pages.caption: 居民·人口
en: But growth brings problems.
The number of private vehicles has risen sharply, so traffic congestion is part of daily life.
Pedestrians wait a long time at crossings, and the air is worse than before.
pages.zh: 老市场附近开了体育设施和图书馆（老市场就位于市中心），当地居民现在半小时就能通勤上班。但发展也带来问题。私家车数量猛增，交通拥堵成了日常。

pages.caption: 文化·传统
en: The city council is trying to protect the past while welcoming the future.
A museum was built to preserve the local heritage and tradition, and a festival celebrates the diversity of the people who live here.
The local media broadcast a programme about the old market, and the audience loved it.
pages.zh: 行人在路口要等很久，空气也比以前差。市政委员会想在迎接未来的同时守住过去。他们建了一座博物馆来保护当地遗产和传统，还有一个节日庆祝居民的文化多样性。

pages.caption: 广播·影响
en: Companies advertise on the same channel, which worries some people: how much influence should they have?
Even entertainment news is paid for by them.
A journalist published a long article about cultural identity.
pages.zh: 当地媒体播了一档关于老市场的节目，观众很喜欢。企业也在同一个频道做广告，这让一些人担心：它们该有多大影响力？连娱乐新闻都是它们出钱做的。

pages.caption: 身份·多样性
en: "A city is not only buildings," she wrote.
"Its value lies in the culture that people share.
" That idea has gone global: the article was read in many countries.
pages.zh: 一位记者发表了一篇关于文化认同的长文。「城市不只是建筑，」她写道，「它的价值在于人们共享的文化。」这个观点已经传遍全球：这篇文章在许多国家被读到。

4.title: A Trip on a Tight Budget

pages.caption: 目的地·行程
en: Last summer my sister and I planned a journey to Italy.
We had a tight budget, so we booked everything online weeks in advance.
Our itinerary was simple: three cities in ten days.
Our first destination was a small town by the sea, which was full of tourists in August.
pages.zh: 去年夏天我和姐姐计划去意大利旅行。预算很紧，所以我们提前几周就在网上把一切订好了。行程很简单：十天三座城市。第一个目的地是海边的一个小镇，八月份满是游客。

pages.caption: 旅程·出发
en: We found cheap accommodation outside the centre and made a reservation at a small hotel.
On the day of departure a storm delayed our flight, and on arrival we discovered that one bag of luggage had not travelled with us.
We did not let it spoil the adventure.
pages.zh: 我们在市中心外面找到便宜的住宿，在一家小旅馆做了预订。出发那天一场暴风雨让航班延误，到达时又发现有一件行李没跟我们一起飞。我们没让它毁了这次冒险。

pages.caption: 导游·探索
en: A friendly guide showed us the old town, and we spent the morning sightseeing.
The scenery from the hill was worth the climb.
In the afternoon we went to explore the market, where I bought a small souvenir for my mother.
pages.zh: 一位友善的导游带我们逛老城，上午我们去观光。从山上看下去的风景，值得爬这一趟。下午我们去逛市场，我给妈妈买了一个小纪念品。

pages.caption: 预算·购买
en: Shopping taught me a few lessons.
I checked every receipt, because you need proof if you want a refund.
I compared prices, asked for a discount, and once found a real bargain.
pages.zh: 购物给我上了几课。我每张收据都留着，因为想退款就得有凭证。我比价、要求打折，还有一次真淘到了便宜货。

pages.caption: 便宜货·负担得起
en: But foreign currency confused me, and I paid too much for a coffee.
Back home, I added up my expense and looked at my income.
I had spent more than I could afford.
pages.zh: 但外币把我绕晕了，一杯咖啡付了太多钱。回家后我把开支加了一遍，又看了看收入。我花的钱超出了能负担的范围。

pages.caption: 货币·债务
en: To avoid getting into debt, I used part of my saving to pay the bill.
The trip was a luxury, but the memories were valuable.
Now I check the price before I make a purchase, and I never forget that a good consumer reads the small print.
pages.zh: 为了不背上债务，我动用了一部分储蓄来付账。这趟旅行算是奢侈，但回忆很宝贵。现在我买东西前会先看价格，也记住了：聪明的消费者会读小字条款。
